name: n8n-outbound-phone-e164-line-type-normalizer
description: n8n workflow that normalizes inbound lead phone numbers to strict E.164, classifies line type (mobile, landline, VoIP) through a carrier lookup, updates HubSpot contact properties and logs masked audit metrics. Safe by default: demo data, DRY_RUN, SANDBOX_MODE and a mock lookup provider.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check:workflow && npm test

author: DH Robin | dhRobin Systems (https://dhrobinsystems.com)
